verdict.rationale: Rollbar documents both custom fingerprinting rules to split wrongly-collapsed occurrences and item merging to combine issues that are really the same bug, directly matching the story. However, this is only first-party docs with no independent/hands-on corroboration of the merge/split workflow in practice. Missing for 10: independent or community validation of merge/split accuracy, UI walkthrough details, and evidence of undo/bulk operations.
